title: mecw-hardcore-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: Corey Irons

won.source: The promotion's own result post of 2 May 2001, its first card since a nine-month hiatus.

lost.source: Reported lost to Johnny Eastland on a later Main Event broadcast; no exact date is given, only that it was reported 7 May 2001.

how: Won the vacant championship; the promotion's own report names no opponent.
note: The first champion since the promotion's return.

title: mecw-hardcore-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: Johnny Eastland

won.source: Reported as already champion in a 7 May 2001 post recapping a Main Event broadcast; no exact date for the match is given.

lost.source: No further Hardcore Championship change survives in the held record.

how: Defeated Corey Irons in what the promotion's own report called a stunning upset.

title: mecw-television-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: Corey Irons

won.source: Both the preview (7 May) and result (11 May) posts date the match only as ‘Wednesday’; the single Wednesday between those two posts is 9 May 2001.

lost.source: The title had become vacant by 7 June 2001, when Johnny Eastland won it from Jaguar; the promotion's own record does not say how or when Irons stopped being champion, though he won the World Championship on 26 May 2001 in the interim.

how: Defeated the Iron Predator for the vacant championship; the win also gave him a first-round bye in the World Championship tournament.

title: mecw-television-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: Johnny Eastland

won.source: Champion by the promotion's own report of 7 June 2001; the exact date of his match against Jaguar is not given.

lost.source: No further Television Championship change survives in the held record.

how: Defeated Jaguar, billed as a rising star, for the vacant championship.

title: mecw-world-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: Corey Irons

won.source: The promotion's own 23 May 2001 announcement names Saturday, 26 May 2001, as Hell Night, its first pay-per-view and the tournament final.

lost.source: A rematch with Johnny Eastland was promised for ‘this Sunday’ in a 7 June 2001 post; no result survives in the held record.

how: Defeated Johnny Eastland in the tournament final to become the first MECW World Champion.

title: mecw-tag-team-championship-mecw-main-event-2001
label: The Misfits

won.source: Reported won on the same Main Event broadcast that saw Johnny Eastland take the Hardcore Championship, in a 7 May 2001 post; the promotion's own report names neither opponents nor an exact date.

lost.source: No further Tag Team Championship change survives in the held record.

how: Won the championship; the promotion's own report does not say how.
note: The title's first champions, so far as the held record shows.
